goal: Return structured cleanup outcomes when process-group inspection transiently fails, preserving the original cancellation contract.
acceptance: EPERM and other unknown probe errors remain unsafe until ESRCH confirms absence.
Exit and close probes cannot escape as uncaught exceptions, and one final verdict determines both result and ownership settlement.
Persistent uncertainty retains an unsettled receipt and blocks recovery; transient errors retain diagnostic evidence.
The original four nested cancellation cases retain their assertions and grace limits.
execution: Separate corrective maintenance delivery; original requirement membership and criteria remain frozen.
